answers: Search relevance across the catalogue is poor and it is several problems at once. Ranking barely uses behavioural signals. Synonyms and misspellings are handled by a hand-maintained list nobody trusts. And we have no way to tell whether a change made results better or worse, so every tweak is an argument. I want to take the whole thing on rather than patch one piece.
